Question: Show the names of singers that have more than one song.

CREATE TABLE "song" (
  "Song_ID" INT PRIMARY KEY,
  "Title" TEXT,
  "Singer_ID" INT,
  "Sales" REAL,
  "Highest_Position" REAL,

);

arguments.sql: SELECT Name FROM singer JOIN song USING (Singer_ID) GROUP BY Singer_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1
